about: Fictional demo notes for the engine's demo adapter. Every name, place and number here is invented. Shown as DEMO.

notes.title: Morning walks before work
notes.text: Alex and Sam walk the canal loop most mornings, about forty minutes. On walking days the step count is higher and Alex sleeps a little longer. (Demo note.)

notes.title: Ten-week running plan
notes.text: Three runs a week: one easy, one tempo, one long run on Sunday. Rest days stay rest days. Week six is the hardest. (Demo note.)

notes.title: Race day checklist
notes.text: Number pinned the night before, porridge two hours ahead, start slower than feels right. Take a small snack at the halfway point, as on the Sunday long runs, so energy holds up. (Demo note.)

notes.title: Sleep routine experiment
notes.text: Screens off at ten, lights low, the same wake time every day for two weeks. Compare sleep minutes before and after. (Demo note.)

notes.title: Evening tea instead of coffee
notes.text: Switched the afternoon coffee for a herbal tea. Falling asleep feels easier, but it has only been a week. (Demo note.)

notes.title: Mood after the long run
notes.text: Sam noticed the evening mood check-in runs higher after the Sunday long run, and lower after a short night. Keep logging both until race day and see whether it holds. (Demo note.)

notes.title: Weekly meal plan
notes.text: Batch-cook lentil soup on Sunday, fish on Wednesday, pasta before the long run. Shopping list lives on the fridge. (Demo note.)

notes.title: Sourdough notes
notes.text: The starter likes the warm shelf. Seventy per cent hydration worked best; the last loaf rose well. (Demo note.)

notes.title: Seedlings on the windowsill
notes.text: Tomatoes and basil sown in trays. Move them out once nights stay above ten degrees. (Demo note.)

notes.title: Raised bed plan
notes.text: One bed for salad, one for beans and courgettes. Water early in the morning. Gardening counts as activity minutes too. (Demo note.)

notes.title: Sunday weekly review
notes.text: Look back at the week: walks, runs, sleep and meals. Pick one small change for next week and write it down here. (Demo note.)
